unlisted_practices: Running an open-weight LLM on a local server behind health system firewalls without external telemetry
Zero-shot LLM extraction of structured data from radiology reports compared against expert human review

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and accuracy of a locally hosted open-source LLM (Llama 3.3 70B) for information extraction from abdominal imaging reports compared to human expert review. It does not test a deployment practice or guardrail.
